'''Tirna''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Raledria]], the world's second-largest economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]]. The city was confirmed as Raledria's national capital following the [[Great Atirhan War]] of 1607–1612 under the [[Grand Amendment]], replacing the earlier capital at [[Zunle]].

Tirna is the headquarters of the [[FLLA]], the international governing body of [[Arraby]] and organiser of the [[FLLA World Cup]]. It is also the seat of the [[Reserve Bank of Raledria]], the issuing authority of the [[Raledrian Kasare]], one of the two globally backed reserve currencies of [[Andah]]. The city hosted the [[1764 FLLA World Cup]] final at the Tirna National Stadium.

The municipal population of Tirna at the [[Raledria|Raledrian]] 1764 census was 5,880,000, but the city forms the political core of the contiguous '''Tirna–Rovik''' metropolitan area with the country's largest city [[Rovik]], the combined metropolitan area carrying a 1764 census population of 19,378,000 and ranking as the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|ninth-largest urban agglomeration in the world]].
